about: ARSC treasure trail caskets: new item definitions appended after rsc-data's last item (1289, Scythe). The clients carry the same three rows in config86.jag (hackmods/rsc-client dist/data204, hackmods/rsc-c cache); the ids must match theirs. Sprite 187 is the casket picture; colour tints its grey pixels (the straps: green, blue, gold), as the party hats are tinted.
